rate_bounds.note: 35 low_confidence rows have four_fifths_ratio > 1 because a small (<30) subgroup outperformed the size-restricted reference group; this is an expected consequence of the reference-selection rule (Step 3), not a computation error, so it is not counted as a violation.

statistical_rigor.notes: Fisher's exact and chi-square (Yates) always computed together for every non-low-confidence cell; statistically_significant verified programmatically to equal fisher_significant AND chi2_significant on all 234 rows; low-confidence cells (candidate_count<30 or reference<30) clearly separated from statistically supported findings throughout the report; the ratio>1-in-low-confidence-cells edge case is explicitly explained rather than hidden.

completeness_of_breakdowns.notes: All 12 job roles and all 5 protected attributes (gender, race_ethnicity, disability_status, veteran_status, age_bracket) are covered both per-role (Section 2 + explicit 12-role gender table in 2.1) and in the ALL_ROLES rollup (Section 3); roles/dimensions with no adequately-sized findings are explicitly called out rather than silently omitted.

clarity_of_findings.notes: Every finding is backed by a table citing exact selection rates, four-fifths ratios, and both fisher_p_value and chi2_p_value side by side; a reader does not need to open the CSV to understand severity.

actionability_of_recommendations.notes: Each of the 6 recommendations names a specific role/group/metric (e.g. 'Financial Analyst Female, ratio 0.44') and explicitly distinguishes 'review process', 'investigate further', and 'collect more data before concluding'.

appropriate_caveats_and_tone.notes: Dedicated Caveats section explicitly separates statistical disparity from proof of discriminatory intent; low-confidence findings are repeatedly flagged as directional-only; language throughout uses 'disparity was observed' rather than definitive claims; synthetic-dataset caveat included.

factual_self_consistency.notes: Independent re-derivation from disparity_metrics.csv found the report's stated flagged count (104), top-5-by-severity list, and every spot-checked ratio/p-value pair across all 5 dimensions matched exactly with zero discrepancies -- verification was clean on the finalized report, so no discrepancy caps this score below 4.
